BACHELOR PROJECT · SERL

Estimating blood sugar levels from infrared blood data

Developed two novel approaches that improved earlier model accuracy, using R and Python for data processing, feature engineering, and model development.

Supervisor · Dr. Mehdi FardmaneshRead preprint ↗

IPM · COGNITIVE NEUROSCIENCE

Characterising body-related patches in local field potentials

Investigating neural responses with naturalistic movie-watching fMRI from the Human Connectome Project, grounded in statistics and data science.

Supervisor · Dr. Reza RajimehrfMRI · LFP · HCP

IPM · NEUROSCIENCE

Predicting functional maps from structural brain data

Using sulcus depth and myelin maps to predict specific functional maps through deep-learning methods.

Supervisor · Dr. Reza RajimehrGDL · Neuroimaging
